source_assets: Original character art for this project; not a runtime screenshot

prompts.listening: Production animation key pose for approved dimensional Phil, using supplied image as strict character identity/style reference. Render ONE full-body Phil at exactly the same scale and portrait framing as the reference, entire hair and sandals visible, same tablet held by his left-side-on-image arm, same clothes/headphones/face/hair/beard/glasses, same warm lighting and stylized 3D quality. Change his pose to LISTENING: mouth gently closed, eyebrows mildly raised in attentiveness, head tilted slightly toward the viewer, his free right-side-on-image hand raised naturally to gently cup/touch the headphone ear cup. Keep warm friendly expression and stable feet. Do not redesign clothing or character. Truly transparent background: every pixel outside the silhouette alpha zero, no glow, no haze, no floor, no cast-shadow rectangle, no text, no additional objects or people. Portrait 1024 by 1536 or higher, high detail. One key pose only, not a sheet.
prompts.thinking: Production THINKING key pose for the supplied approved dimensional Phil. Preserve this exact friendly adult human character, stylized 3D rendering, chestnut long hair and beard, round glasses, orange headphones, tie-dye shirt, brown fringed vest, peace pendant, patched flared jeans, sandals and gray tablet. ONE full-body figure, same portrait scale as reference, both feet entirely visible. Phil is thoughtfully studying his tablet: chin slightly down, eyes looking at tablet, one eyebrow gently raised, lips closed, free right-side-on-image hand lightly touching his beard/chin with a relaxed thoughtful gesture, tablet supported in other arm at chest height. Curious and capable, not sad or confused. Same recognizable face and character proportions, no costume redesign. Detailed hair, denim, cloth and warm skin lighting matching the reference. Truly transparent alpha background everywhere outside silhouette, including gaps, no glow/haze/backdrop/floor/shadow plane, no text, no additional subjects. High-resolution portrait 1024x1536 or higher. Single production pose, no sheet.
prompts.greeting: Create the GREETING animation key pose of the exact approved dimensional Phil in the supplied reference. One full-body friendly adult tech-hippie character with the SAME recognizable face, brown long hair/full beard, round glasses, orange headphones, tie-dye shirt, fringed brown patchwork vest, gold peace pendant, patched flared blue jeans, brown sandals, gray tablet in his left-side-on-image arm. Change ONLY his greeting expression/pose: warm closed-mouth smile, free right-side-on-image arm bent with open palm raised beside his head in a natural friendly wave, five relaxed fingers. Keep face proportions, feet, scale and portrait framing consistent with reference. Full hair and sandals visible with margins. Same tactile high-end stylized 3D animation rendering and warm lighting on character. Real transparent alpha outside silhouette and in gaps, no background or glow/haze/floor/drop shadow, no text, no multiple figures or panels. High-resolution 1024x1536 portrait or greater.
prompts.speaking: Edit the supplied approved dimensional Phil portrait for a TALKING MOUTH animation key. Preserve the ENTIRE image, framing, exact identity, body pose, head angle, eyes, glasses, headphones, hairstyle, outfit, tablet, palms and feet in exactly the same positions. Change ONLY the tiny mouth/lip area under the moustache to a naturally open speaking mouth, modest relaxed open 'ah', visible small upper teeth and soft dark mouth cavity, not a grin and not shocked. The beard and moustache around it remain unchanged. This is a matching lip animation frame for the closed-mouth reference; absolutely no head/body movement or reframing. Same single full-body portrait and rendering quality, actual transparent alpha background, no additional backgrounds, objects, text or panels.
prompts.blink: Edit target: supplied approved dimensional Phil. Make a matching BLINK key frame. Preserve absolutely everything in exactly the same positions and framing: body, tablet, open free hand, hair/beard, glasses, face shape, head angle, headphones, clothes, feet, expression and lighting. Change ONLY his two eyes behind the round glasses: both eyelids gently fully closed in a natural brief blink, relaxed, not squinting and no eyebrow change. Keep glasses rims intact and unchanged. Identical full-body portrait, true transparent alpha background, no extra text/objects/panels. A precise eye-animation frame, no pose or character redesign.
prompts.error: Create a gentle ERROR / UNAVAILABLE key pose for the exact approved dimensional Phil in the reference. Preserve his recognizable friendly adult face, long brown hair/full beard, round glasses, orange headphones, tie-dye shirt, fringed brown vest, peace pendant, patched flared jeans, sandals and gray tablet in the other arm. One full-body portrait at same scale and framing, feet visible. Expression: mildly concerned/apologetic raised inner eyebrows, small closed mouth with slightly downturned corners, soft reassuring eyes. Free right-side-on-image palm open low in a restrained small 'I could not complete that' shrug. Not smiling, not crying, not angry, not celebrating. Keep the same stylized 3D tactile rendering and character identity, no redesign or change of age. Truly transparent alpha outside silhouette, no glow/haze/background/floor/shadow plane, no symbols/text/panels/other characters. High resolution 1024x1536 or higher.
prompts.idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution TV assistant character review sample B, dimensional animated-film Phil. Input image is the identity reference, a sprite atlas of the SAME recurring human character named Phil; extract and reinterpret his identity, do NOT reproduce the sheet or make multiple characters. Create ONE full-body high-end stylized 3D character render of Phil, like a beautifully art-directed animated feature character with tactile materials and appealing expressive eyes. Preserve his recognizable original personality and identifying design: friendly middle-aged retro tech-hippie man; abundant tousled shoulder-length chestnut brown hair; full long scruffy chestnut beard/moustache; small round dark wire-frame spectacles; warm brown eyes and bushy brows; bronze/orange over-ear headphones; vivid orange-blue-purple tie-dye T-shirt; brown fringed vest with a purple patch and flower; gold peace-sign necklace; blue flared jeans with colorful fabric patches and flower embroidery; brown sandals; familiar small slate-gray tablet tucked securely under one arm. Friendly attentive closed-mouth smile, slightly raised brow, other hand in a small natural palm-up 'How can I help?' gesture. Upright stable stance. Same adult human character and distinctive face, no tuxedo or formal servant uniform. Keep the original appealing cartoon proportions, a slightly oversized expressive head, not photorealistic and not a tiny baby. Material detail: individually sculpted hair clumps with fine flyaways, softly textured skin, fine worn denim weave, embroidered flower stitches, suede vest, warm metallic headphone cups and realistic optical spectacle reflections without obscuring his eyes. Soft warm studio key light and subtle cool edge light on character only, restrained highlights. Full figure from hair to both sandals, portrait framing with generous transparent margins. Truly transparent background with clean alpha; NO colored backdrop, NO gradient, NO halo/glow behind the figure, NO floor plane, NO drop shadow background. Single character only, no text, no labels, no watermarks. Review concept only, not a sprite sheet. Maximum practical high-resolution portrait detail, ideally at least 2048 pixels tall.
